title: Agent share-of-voice drop — hero SKU cited 11 vs competitor's 29
narrative: Writes land in the PIM first, then feeds regenerate from the corrected record, then the policy schema deploys. Scout’s battery is rescheduled last so the first re-score reads a settled catalogue.
status_note: Execute · 0 of 4 pushed · 13 line items staged

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

items.name: Walmart attribute mapping repair
items.detail: Capacity, dimensions and heat rating remap to the correct Walmart field IDs. Fixed at the source, so every channel regenerates from one corrected record.

items.name: Attribute enrichment · 12 hero SKUs
items.detail: 26 category-required fields per SKU from supplier spec sheets. Induction compatibility, oven-safe temperature, handle material, weight, dishwasher safety.

items.name: GTIN backfill · 43 variants
items.detail: Codes taken from supplier records and validated against the GS1 check digit before write. Two surfaces cannot see a variant without one.

items.name: Heat-rating copy conflict
items.detail: The PDP paragraph claiming 500°F is rewritten to cite the 450°F spec field. Copy now generates from the record rather than sitting beside it.

items.name: Walmart feed rebuild
items.detail: Full rebuild rather than a delta, because nine days of attribute drift cannot be reconciled incrementally.

items.name: Regeneration cadence · all channels
items.detail: Shopify stays live, the three marketplace feeds move to a two-hour schedule. Brings freshness inside the 6-hour floor from Reason.

items.name: Stale-price pull rule
items.detail: A price older than its validity window is withdrawn instead of published. An absent price costs a citation; a wrong one costs trust.

targets.name: Web · policy schema deploy
targets.meta: 3 policy types · 1,240 PDPs · one source record

items.name: MerchantReturnPolicy · 45-day window
items.detail: Publishes the real return window as structured policy, which is what removes the third-party 14-day answer from the surfaces.

items.name: ShippingDeliveryTime · per region
items.detail: Handling time, transit time and cutoff published per region rather than described in a paragraph.

items.name: Warranty terms
items.detail: Absent entirely before this deploy — the field the comparison queries look for when they rank durability.

items.name: Battery expansion · 120 queries
items.detail: The 46 existing queries plus 74 drawn from the constraints shoppers actually used in the mismatch and missing-attribute rows.

items.name: Competitor set · 2 → 3
items.detail: Adds the third competitor that appeared in 18 of the 46 answers and was not being tracked.

items.name: Answer diffing against the canonical record
items.detail: Every sampled answer is diffed against the PIM automatically, so a mismatch surfaces the same day rather than at the weekly review.

flags.rule: An answer contradicts the canonical record
flags.action: Raises a mismatch flag here with the full trace.

flags.rule: Citation share falls more than 3pp on any surface
flags.action: Re-runs the battery on that surface and notifies Scout.
Sends the deferred items back to Decide with the re-score attached.

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, a detected staleness raises a flag on this card and waits for you.
